scenario.name: D1_nominal_detection_map
scenario.claim: With low drift and reliable acoustic report exchange, the swarm builds a usable contact map.
scenario.falsifying: Recall below 90%, localization RMSE above 20m, or false-map rate above 0.35 per true contact.
scenario.mechanism: Parallel-lane sweep; fixed contacts; low random drift; no report loss; no anchors.

scenario.name: D2_report_loss_30pct
scenario.claim: The map degrades gracefully under 30% acoustic report loss because multiple drones and gossip provide redundant observations.
scenario.falsifying: Recall below 75% or localization RMSE above 30m.
scenario.mechanism: Same field as D1 with independent 30% report loss on each acoustic exchange.

scenario.name: D3_random_walk_drift
scenario.claim: Moderate per-drone dead-reckoning drift reduces absolute accuracy but still leaves a useful hazard map.
scenario.falsifying: Recall below 70% or localization RMSE above 45m.
scenario.mechanism: Per-drone localization bias follows an independent random walk; no anchors.

scenario.name: D4_directed_current
scenario.claim: A shared directed current is less damaging than independent drift because relative coverage remains coherent.
scenario.falsifying: Recall below 75% or localization RMSE above 45m.
scenario.mechanism: All drones experience an unmodeled 0.03m/s lateral current while sweeping.

scenario.name: D5_anchor_reorientation
scenario.claim: Sparse fixed-point reorientation substantially improves map accuracy under random drift.
scenario.falsifying: Anchor-aided RMSE is not at least 40% lower than the matched no-anchor control.
scenario.mechanism: A quarter of drones periodically acquire noisy fixed-point position fixes and use them to correct the shared map frame.

scenario.name: D6_calloff_on_stale_map
scenario.claim: When drift grows beyond the mission envelope without anchors, the system marks the map unsafe instead of pretending it is reliable.
scenario.falsifying: Map uncertainty exceeds the calloff threshold for more than 120s before calloff.
scenario.mechanism: High random drift, no anchors. The mission should call off when propagated map uncertainty exceeds 60m.

scenario.name: D7_bounded_acoustic_bottleneck
scenario.claim: When acoustic exchange is narrow and lossy, distributed maps no longer collapse to post-mission centralized fusion, but still outperform local-only maps.
scenario.falsifying: Distributed recall remains indistinguishable from centralized logs, or falls back to local-only recall.
scenario.mechanism: Nominal survey with 90m comms range, one report per neighbor exchange, and 30% acoustic exchange loss.
